text:
Dawson Mercer's season split in two on Oct. 23, when New Jersey sent him to Winnipeg in the Connor Hellebuyck trade. He has played 16 games as a Jet, and the moment that stuck was Nov. 10: two goals against the Devils, the team that drafted him 18th overall in 2020. He scored twice again two nights later against Dallas.

Since then, nothing: no goals in seven games. Over his last ten he has 5 goals on 1.8 expected, so the hot week was as much about finishing as about chances, and the quiet stretch is the correction. For the full season his 5 goals match his 5.1 expected almost exactly, which is the honest picture of where he is.

He plays 15.7 minutes and Winnipeg breaks about even at 5v5 with him on (50.8% of shot attempts). Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting 1.6 shots per 60 off passes across the slot or from behind the net last season, the most dangerous kind of look. He needs linemates who find him there.
headline: Mercer's revenge game was the high point so far
